latestVersion.changelog:
Agent Reach 1.0.0 — Initial Release

- Adds support to search and read from 14 platforms, including Twitter/X, Reddit, YouTube, GitHub, Bilibili, XiaoHongShu, Douyin, Weibo, WeChat Articles, LinkedIn, Instagram, RSS, Exa web search, and any web page.
- Offers one-command install and zero configuration for 8 channels.
- Includes diagnostic tool (`agent-reach doctor`) to check channel availability and troubleshoot issues.
- Provides a comprehensive usage guide for platform-specific commands and setup.
- Enforces clear workspace rules for file management and persistent data.
- Supports channel setup and interactive use via keyword triggers in both English and Chinese.
